description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Quantum Sky is hiring a Software Developer, Applications (FM Application Developer) to support the Defense Health Agency’s E-Commerce Operational Systems Support contract. The role develops, sustains, tests, and supports custom extensions and interfaces for the Oracle Federal Financials application suite, including federal accounting modernization and production operations.
Applications Software Developer developing and sustaining Oracle Federal Financials modules, PL/SQL routines, and financial interfaces

Responsibilities:
• Perform full lifecycle development, sustainment engineering, and bug fixing across core Oracle Federal Financials COTS modules and DHA custom extensions, including:

  + **Core COTS Financial Modules:** General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Purchasing (PO), Cost Management, Federal Financials, and Sub-Ledger Accounting (SLA).
  + **Specialized Custom Extensions:** Healthcare Claims Processing extensions, Pharmacy Module extensions, Office of General Counsel (OGC) Debt Management module, and Oracle Projects.
  + **Reporting & Interfaces:** SplashBI transactional reporting, Oracle Developer Suite Forms & Reports, Connect:Direct scripts, and Workflow Builder processes
• Develop, modify, and optimize SQL queries, PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, database triggers, and batch concurrent programs executing in a UNIX/Linux RHEL environment
• Support claims-to-invoice conversion routines that interface healthcare claim data from the TRICARE Encounter Data System (TEDS) into OFF financial accounting structures
• Contribute to the implementation of mandated federal initiatives under the guidance of Senior Developers and Architects:

* **Government Invoicing (G-Invoicing):** Support development of data exchange objects, attributes, and automated settlement workflows for Intragovernmental Transactions (IGT) Buy/Sell activity using Treasury data standards.
* **Central Accounting Reporting System (CARS):** Build and maintain ETL routines and database ingestion scripts to process the CARS Transactional Data Extract (CTDE) file, automating daily cash transaction reconciliation against Treasury disbursement data.
* **Standard Financial Information Structure (SFIS / SLOA / CCAS):** Modify OFF accounting flexfields, database tables, and validation logic to maintain compliance with DoD Business Enterprise Architecture (BEA), Standard Line of Accounting (SLOA), and Common Cost Accounting Structure (CCAS).
* **PRISM to OFF Interface Handshake:** Build and test automated commitment and obligation validation interfaces between OFF and Global Unison PRISM procurement software prior to contract modifications.
* **DFAS DDRS & WAWF Interfaces:** Maintain transaction generation files and connectivity schemas transferring financial ledger data to the Defense Departmental Reporting System (DDRS) and Wide Area Workflow (WAWF) via the Global Exchange (GEX).
* **CRMSIT Payment Testing :** Assist in generating test claim data files, running cycle processing, and executing end-to-end payment simulations with TEDS during biennial integration testing
• Maintain and manage code across **five (5) isolated environments**: Development, System Test, QA/Pre-Prod (User Acceptance Testing), Benchmark, and Production
• Conduct all development and unit testing strictly within the Development environment, accessed exclusively via the secure **DHA DCOPS Application Virtualization Hosting Environment (AVHE)**
• Adhere strictly to environment access segregation: developers are prohibited from direct data access in QA/Pre-Prod and Production; package deployment scripts for DBA and system administrator execution
• Utilize enterprise Configuration Management tools (GIT / GitHub, Micro Focus SBM, HP Quality Center/ALM) for software versioning, branching, check-in/check-out, and defect tracking
• Author and execute comprehensive Unit Test plans, and support System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), capturing test artifacts and screen evidence
• Support resolution of application defects to meet contractual quality thresholds: 100% of major defects, 100% of moderate defects, and 95% of minor defects resolved prior to release
• Develop code strictly aligned with DISA Application Security and Development STIGs, NIST SP 800-53 security controls, and static/dynamic scanning guidelines (Fortify, SonarQube, VS Code, Burp Suite)
• Support Section 508 Accessibility compliance across all developed forms, screens, and report layouts in accordance with WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards
• Participate in rotating operational sustainment to diagnose application processing errors, concurrent manager locks, and batch abends
• Support contract restoration timeframes:
  + **End-of-Month (EOM) / Fiscal Year-End:** Restore production disruptions within 4 hours maximum allowable downtime during the 5 days prior to, 5 days after EOM, and throughout October.
  + **Standard Operations:** Restore production issues within 8 hours; non-production disruptions within 24 hours

Requirements:
• Must be a United States Citizen (mandatory for DHA facility access and IT-II network authorization; dual citizenship cannot be accommodated)
• Must qualify for and maintain a DoD IT Level II Privileged Access designation per DoD 5200.2-R
• Must hold an approved IAT Level II baseline certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+ ce, CCNA Security, CySA+, GSEC) upon hire or obtain it within three (3) months of starting employment
• Must complete relevant OS/DBMS Operating Environment training
• Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline
• Fifteen (15) years of documented experience in software applications development may be substituted in lieu of a bachelor's degree
• Minimum of one (1) year of hands-on experience in Oracle® Federal Financials R-12 application development (utilizing Developer Suite Forms, Reports, and Workflow Builder) on a UNIX/Linux environment supporting an application of the size and complexity of DHA ECS OFF
• Hands-on proficiency with Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) / Federal Financials R12 architecture, database schemas, table relationships, and concurrent program registration
• Proficiency in PL/SQL and SQL development, including stored procedures, packages, functions, triggers, and performance tuning (indexes, execution plans)
• Practical experience utilizing Oracle Developer Suite (Forms 10g/11g/12c and Reports Builder) and Oracle Workflow Builder
• Experience developing and troubleshooting in a Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) or UNIX server environment utilizing shell scripting (Bash, Korn shell) and basic command-line utilities
• Experience with source code version control tools (e.g., Git, GitHub, PVCS) and structured SDLC processes (IEEE 1074)
• Active or favorably adjudicated Tier 3 (T3) / NACLC investigation (SF-86)
• Ability to obtain interim T3/IT-II prior to onboarding

Preferred:
• Functional familiarity with federal accounting concepts, including the United States Standard General Ledger (USSGL), Prompt Payment Act, Antideficiency Act, and Treasury financial standards
• Experience supporting interfaces to DoD or federal external systems (e.g., WAWF, GEX, SPS, TEDS, CARS, G-Invoicing)
• Familiarity with SplashBI reporting or Oracle BI Publisher template development
• Familiarity with AWS GovCloud hosting environments, Oracle WebLogic, and PKI/CAC authentication integrations
